name: Kékcse (Hungary)
description: White field with a blue horizontal stripe along the top edge and a red stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kékcse: a red, white and green shield with a bird and a fish, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling, above a scroll inscribed KÉKCSE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kékcse arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
